templates.title: MCP Router
templates.sub_title: One endpoint for every MCP server
templates.description: MCP gateway: install MCP servers from registries or npm and serve them all over streamable HTTP, one endpoint each plus a merged one. Needs a Postgres you already run: set DATABASE_URL to it and BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -hex 32) before deploying, then open port 3000: with SECURE_LOCAL_NET=true you are signed in as the local admin. Make API keys for MCP clients in Settings. To run Postgres beside it, create it as an Application from qnap/docker-compose.yml instead.
